EXEC.summary: Runs a procedure or dynamic SQL; mark OUTPUT at both ends
EXEC.examples.basic.title: Basic usage
EXEC.examples.basic.sql: EXEC sys.sp_helpdb @dbname = 'master'   -- Named argument, any order
EXEC.examples.return-value.title: Return code via @ret
EXEC.examples.output-trap.title: The OUTPUT parameter trap
EXEC.examples.output-trap.sql:
CREATE PROCEDURE #Lib_GetCopyCount @Branch varchar(10), @CopyCount int OUTPUT
AS
    SELECT @CopyCount = 3;   -- Sample value; would query Cat_BookCopy in practice
GO
DECLARE @n int = -1;
EXEC #Lib_GetCopyCount @Branch = 'A01', @CopyCount = @n;         -- Missing OUTPUT
SELECT @n AS Missed;    -- Result: -1, value never came back (caller must mark OUTPUT too)
EXEC #Lib_GetCopyCount @Branch = 'A01', @CopyCount = @n OUTPUT;  -- Correct
SELECT @n AS Correct;   -- Result: 3
GO
EXEC.examples.insert-exec.title: INSERT ... EXEC captures results
EXEC.examples.result-sets.title: Renaming columns with RESULT SETS
EXEC.examples.result-sets.sql:
CREATE PROCEDURE #Lib_RawNames
AS
    SELECT 'A01' AS Col1, 10 AS Col2;
GO
EXEC #Lib_RawNames
    WITH RESULT SETS ((Branch varchar(10), CopyCount int));  -- Renames Col1/Col2
GO

THROW.summary: Throws an error; needs a semicolon before it; codes >=50000.
THROW.examples.basic.title: Basic usage
THROW.examples.rethrow.title: Re-throwing inside CATCH
THROW.examples.rethrow.sql:
BEGIN TRY
    SELECT 1 / 0;              -- Triggers a divide-by-zero error
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    -- Could log the error here before re-throwing it unchanged
    THROW;                      -- Only valid inside CATCH
END CATCH;
THROW.examples.semicolon-trap.title: Missing semicolon fails
THROW.examples.error-number-trap.title: Error number must be ≥ 50000
THROW.examples.error-number-trap.sql:
BEGIN TRY
    THROW 999, N'Demo', 1;   -- A custom error must be >= 50000
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    SELECT ERROR_MESSAGE() AS Msg;
END CATCH;
-- Result: compile error, error_number is below 50000

BULK INSERT.summary: Bulk loads a file into a table; path is server-side
BULK INSERT.examples.basic.title: Basic usage
BULK INSERT.examples.csv-format.title: CSV format with FIRSTROW
BULK INSERT.examples.csv-format.sql:
-- The path below must be one the SQL Server service can see (not the client's path)
BULK INSERT #Lib_ReaderImport
FROM 'D:/import/Lib_Reader.csv'
WITH (
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    FIRSTROW = 2,     -- Skips the header row
    FIELDQUOTE = '"'  -- Wraps fields containing a comma in double quotes
);
-- Result: needs a real path to run; a wrong path reports OS error 3 (file not found)
BULK INSERT.examples.delimiter.title: Custom delimiter and TABLOCK
BULK INSERT.examples.delimiter.sql:
-- Path to replace: a path reachable from the server side
BULK INSERT #Lib_ReaderImport
FROM 'D:/import/Lib_Reader.txt'
WITH (
    FIELDTERMINATOR = '|',
    TABLOCK
);
-- Result: needs a real path; TABLOCK locks the whole table during the load to speed it up
